text: When I arrived at Miracles Asia I wasn't aware of exactly how unwell I was.  I was originally going to go for 30 days but decided to stay for 60.  Going to Miracles Asia was the most transformative thing I have ever done in my life.  The blend of world-class therapists, great accomodation and food, amazing outings, access to one of the best health clubs in Thailand, and a weekly massage all provided the exact environment I needed to look at myself.  The whole team are empathetic, caring and skilled at what they do.  I discovered a new sane and calm life...thankyou Miracles Asia.

My experience at Miracles of Asia Rehabilitation Center has truly changed my life.
From the very beginning, the owner personally picked me up from the airport, which immediately set the tone for the level of care and dedication this program provides. I stayed for over 60 days, and I have never experienced such genuine concern for my safety, mental health, and sobriety anywhere else.
The staff, counselors, therapists, and the clinical director are without question the best mental health professionals I have ever encountered. They use a multi-faceted recovery approach that addresses the mind, body, and spirit. Justin brings incredibly valuable Buddhist techniques he studied for several years in India, which have become essential tools in my recovery. Joe, the clinical director, is a U.S. veteran who worked for the Veterans Affairs system, and his experience, leadership, and understanding of trauma—especially for veterans—is unmatched.
What truly sets this place apart is that the counselors and staff come from all walks of life, and many are in recovery themselves. They don’t just teach recovery—they live it. They genuinely understand my struggles. Kane a licensed psychotherapist, opened my mind to new perspectives and practical tools I can use every day to stay sober. Danny, who has worked the 12 Steps and has been sober longer than I’ve been alive, brings a light-hearted but deeply knowledgeable approach. He taught me how to work the 12 Steps properly, how to attend meetings, conduct myself, and most importantly, how to prevent relapse from alcohol and marijuana.
Although this is a 5-star luxury rehab, it is still affordable for veterans. I did not have to pay a single dollar—my treatment was billed through the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs. I strongly encourage any soldiers, sailors, or veterans who are struggling to seek out this program. They can help you with anything you are dealing with.
The accommodations are beyond incredible: private luxury rooms, private pools, and the best food I’ve had in Thailand—honestly some of the best food I’ve had anywhere. The classes helped me take a deep, introspective look at my life and begin healing the trauma that led me to drink and smoke in the first place. There are nurses and therapists on staff 24/7, providing constant support.
They respect personal beliefs and allow you to attend the church of your choice on Sundays. Every weekend includes amazing outings—whitewater rafting, James Bond Island, elephant sanctuaries, beach barbecues, temples, and caves. Every Saturday, we go to the beach and enjoy Michelin-star-rated meals at places like the Gibbon Sanctuary. They also take you to the best gym and spa in Phuket, where Thai Olympic athletes train.
The small process groups were especially important for me because I have social anxiety. Being in groups of three or four people allowed me to open up and safely discuss deep trauma. Through this, I made lifelong connections and realized I am not alone in what I’ve been through.
I am actively in recovery today, and I know with certainty that I will never drink alcohol or smoke marijuana again. I owe a debt to this program that I can never fully repay. Miracles of Asia gave me my life back.
If you are struggling—especially if you are a veteran—this place can save your life.

Miracles Asia is just that, a miracle. From the luxurious, spacious, and safe accommodations, delicious and healthy meals, supportive and kind staff, integrative and solution based classes, all encompassing treatment programs, and incredibly knowledgeable and helpful therapists, Miracles Asia is in a league of their own. I will be forever grateful and indebted to Miracles Asia for saving my life and giving me the tools I need to be successful in this amazing new life of recovery. Thank you, thank you, thank you.

I was at rock bottom when I arrived at Miracles, I was extremely scared and nervous,  immediately my nerves and worries dissipated by receiving such amazing care and kindness throughout my stay.  The staff went way above and beyond to support and help me through my addictions and my physical health during my stay.

Miracles very much became  my family!  The sessions were extremely well thought out and the day trips were truly amazing!  Food incredible, rooms and surroundings are absolutely gorgeous and all the staff are so kind and accommodating.   I’m so glad I chose the 90 day program to fully benefit my ongoing sobriety.  I can’t recommend this wonderful rehab highly enough.  Thank you Mark to you and all your staff for your truly wonderful support throughout my stay.  I miss my time there greatly “Miracles Asia”will remain always in my “Happy Memories” bank!   Thanks to all for giving me my life back.

Miracles was my 3rd private rehab center (yeah, repeat offender on the relapsing). 100+ days out of Miracles and I’m confident that it will be my last rehab center. The staff were warm and professional, competent, qualified, and caring. Some things that set Miracles apart from the other private rehabs I attended:
1)	Respect: as a client I was treated like a competent adult that was trying to address a problem, not like an addict that was incapable of making life decisions and needed to be told what to do every moment of the day.
2)	In-patient programming: the programming is diverse, relevant and engaging. At each of the other rehabs I felt there was ultimately a lack of programming at the level that could be useful to an adult professional with an addiction issue. In other rehabs the focus is on a different type of clientele that may need education and guidance on the very basics of living a healthy life.
3)	Authenticity: while the staff at any rehab I have attended have a caring and patient manner, at Miracles I felt the owners and staff actually, truly cared about me.
4)	Community. I greatly appreciated the feeling of belonging to the “Miracles family” while there. On outings, the interactions with the staff that accompany us is more one of peers than of supervisor and supervisees. We all share meals at a common dinner table. I should point out that the food was absolutely amazing. Though the meals are eaten together, for most meals you choose your own dishes from a menu that includes both Thai and international food, prepared by a world-class chef.
5)	Exit planning and aftercare: this might be the most critical big difference. At Miracles you leave with a solid exit strategy in place. You get a continuing-care supervisor and a comprehensive after-care package where you zoom into sessions. I still join the evening 12-step meetings by zoom once a week.
Miracles is a smaller center, so doesn’t have the extensive facilities of the other 2 centers I attended. There is emphasis on 12-step recovery methods, but also includes cognitive behavioral modalities, mindful meditation and some holistic. Physical fitness is provided by 3 weekly scheduled group trips to a nearby large and comprehensive fitness center (all basic facility use included in your Miracles package)
Just completed my second trip to Miracles Asia and already feeling grateful and sure of my reasoning as to why I chose to commit myself here above all others. …

Unfortunately / fortunately I spent 30 days at another rehab in Bangkok before I went over to miracles . I’ve never been to rehab before and this trip was my only hope at recovery . I had no expectations at the first rehab so I followed the guidelines and did all of the work as suggested but I left there worst off mentally than the day that I got there . My family was tired and they were actually planning to just take me back home when Mark returned a call to my brother and I was on a call with Ryan within a day followed by a video call with Kane and and a personal call with Mark .
I had absolutely no expectations going in and honestly I went with a wall up at first because I hated the thought of doing all of the same work again .
From the time I walked into miracles I felt protected but also ‘called out’ , which in my opinion is exactly what all addicts need .
Addiction is a family disease and at miracles it is treated that way which was a miracle for my family . It’s is by far the most amazing environment to heal in . All of the staff members are amazing and attentive while also being honest and very straightforward which again is EXACTLY what an addict needs . ALL of the luxuries are there for a reason so don’t be fooled lol . …Miracles is for people who WANT to get better ! Not for people who think they are being forced .
It cannot work if you do not work , but once you want to be healed then there is NO WAY that you can fail at Miracles .
I was lucky enough to have crossed paths with the most amazing bunch of people during my stay . We bonded like family and now have friendships that will last a lifetime .
The packed schedule makes it impossible for you to disconnect and trust me …I’ve seen people try very hard to disconnect but the team at miracles has a plan for all of our plans . They’ve thought of everything and their approach is filled with the utmost amount of love and genuine care. If you want to get better , this is the perfect place to do it . It’s not easy …it’s the furthest thing from easy ….but it’s WORTH it ! I couldn’t see a light at all ….my plan was to be dead before the end of the year … God brought me back to life through Miracles . To be honest , getting rid of the drug was the easy part …getting rid of ME was the hard part but  It was by far the single most amazing journey that I’ve ever been on .
I left miracles as a new member of an exclusive club for humans with super powers (or atleast that’s what I tell my brain lol)  …I have a new family …a large one …I have friends all over the world who check on me daily . Thank you to every single person at miracles ! Mark , Boo , Peter ,Maria , Ali , Emmet , Max , Justin , Ash, Kane , and most importantly Di !! I love you guys ….you all are my forever miracles! 🥰🥰 thank you !

text:
I've just spent an incredible two months of healing, revitalisation and self discovery at Miracles Asia. Words don't quite suffice in attempting to describe what my experience was at this incredible place. But, I'll give it a go.

Firstly, Miracles is more of a family and a village rather than a 'treatment facility'. It certainly fits the prerequisite of being a top class treatment facility, though. The experienced staff that have been carefully cultivated are in my opinion of the highest calibre. High levels of mental health and addiction oriented specialisation/education, professionalism, discretion, a depth of experience in the field of addiction, high standards of practical knowledge and most of all genuine compassion, kindness, humour, humility and good intentions. When I say it's like a family it's because from the minute you arrive you are taken into the fold and embraced as one of the 'tribe'.

When you arrive from your country of origin you are met at the airport with VIP service and in my case with a warm embrace from the Managing Director, Mark. From here you are taken by the driver to your home for your early recovery journey to begin. Here you are met by friendly warm staff who cater to your every need. Very comfortable, spacious and clean bedrooms that are taken care of daily including having your bed made down at night and warm herbal tea prepared and left in your room to help with having a healthy sleep routine established. It's the little things!

From my experience, and from what people that have since left Miracles have said, the kind of individual and groups of people that are attracted to Miracles are special. It is in the groups that the family feel is established through days and weeks of bonding throughout the rigorous program provided there. It is here that you learn an enormous amount about yourself, underlying mental health issues that need addressing and the disease of addiction that you will find most of you have in common.

The food is incredible catering to all diets, the grounds are safe and secure leaving you feeling able to be vulnerable allowing the healing to take place, there is a small gymnasium at Miracles to use at your convenience as well as having access to a world class facility nearby complete with an olympic sized swimming pool, chiropractor, physiotherapist and massage therapist and Miracles itself is located in a quiet peaceful part of Phuket surrounded by mountains and jungle making for a tranquil morning walk and peaceful nights sleep, yoga sessions several times a week and the added bonus of getting off grounds on a range of different excursions on Sunday's allowing for exploration of some of the beautiful countryside, restaurants and islands that are all close by.

I feel whole, sane and centred after my stay at Miracles and I would definitely recommend it for anyone struggling on their own with addiction issues and ready to seek out help to get your life back on track again.

text: I had a fantastic experience in my 60 days stay at Miracles Asia. The professionalism of the company and the excellent facilities truly stood out. The teachers conducting the classes were top-notch, making my time here both enjoyable and enriching. Glad I had the opportunity to connect with Miracles Asia.

I have just completed my First full Year of full Sobriety after years of battle with Alcohol (my first rehab elsewhere back in October 2018). After my stay in Miracles I was fully supported by the Miracles extended care and network of solid …

If you read the reviews below, you’ll hear a lot about how ‘Miracles Saved My Life’.

And you might naturally be a bit sceptical.

Please don’t be.

Miracles is an extraordinary place in so many ways. It is substance agnostic, so that brings together a bunch of addicts with various journeys to get there, and it is also small. Which means it quickly becomes a real COMMUNITY for everyone there, and until you have experienced that as an addict you cannot understand how important – no, life giving – it is.

From the moment I was met at the airport, there was a literal arm around my shoulder and a metaphorical one for the rest of my time there. I was an idiot drunk at risk of losing everything important in my life (and I still have a lot of work to do on that front), but without Miracles there would be no chance.
There’s not a single member of staff – including the incredibly lovely back of house team – who aren’t dedicated and wonderful. The kindness shown to me in the first couple of hours of being there was off the scale (Sweet and Ali, I’m looking at you two) and was a total game changer. Especially if you’re feeling like a scared loser.

There were a number of clients there during my time who had been to rehab before, sometimes multiple times. Without exception, they said Miracles was by far the best one they’d ever been to.

Many reasons for that, but one of the main ones is that the owner, Mark, lives and breathes it. He is there every day; not just as a drop-in but leading and inspiring everyone.

If you have an addiction problem, get yourself to Miracles if you are at all able to.

It does what is says on the tin.

I had an incredibly positive experience at Miracles Asia,  From the moment I arrived, I felt welcomed and supported by a compassionate and professional team. The staff truly cares about each individual’s journey, offering personalized treatment plans that address both physical and emotional needs. The facilities are top-notch, and the environment is calm, healing, and conducive to recovery. I particularly appreciated the variety of therapy options available, including both group and one-on-one sessions, which helped me stay motivated and focused on my goals.

I want to extend my heartfelt gratitude to everyone at Miracles for their unwavering dedication and support. Thanks to them, I feel stronger, more confident, and equipped to move forward on my path to recovery. Highly recommend this place to anyone seeking help!

Life-Changing Experience at Miracles Asia!

I cannot express enough how grateful I am for the team at Miracles Asia. From …

I contacted Miracles for a family member. The undivided attention, listening ear, compassion and understanding of what we as a family were going through was exceptional. The communication was great and the guidance we got was phenomenal.
Thankyou so much for helping and supporting our family in the way that you did. We will never forget that feeling. We will be forever thankful.✨

Miracles Asia: A Turning Point in My Recovery
Having been through two rehab programs before and relapsing, I didn’t expect much when I found myself on the path to Miracles Asia, my third attempt at rehabilitation. I arrived with little hope that this experience would be any more successful than the last, but I was at rock bottom, desperate for help and ready to find my way out.
The staff at Miracles Asia – from the doctor to the therapists, carers, and nurses – are experienced, encouraging, understanding, and genuinely caring. Every member of the team, in every aspect of the program, became someone I deeply appreciated during my stay. They created an environment that promotes a real sense of safety and security.
The program itself takes a holistic approach, addressing the mind, body, and spirit. I’m not naturally someone who opens up easily, but the fellowship and bonds formed with the other clients were crucial to my healing. I found myself trusting in the process and in the community, which made all the difference.
To be honest, the accommodation and food were the least of my concerns when I arrived – I just wanted a chance at recovery and real solutions. That said, the rooms were lovely and the meals were plentiful, more than adequate for what I needed.
When I was ready to make a change, I had to surrender to the process. I’ve now completed the program and am actively using many of the skills I learnt during my time there. While I’ll never be complacent – addiction is a cunning disease – I’ve never felt this free in my life. I feel optimistic and incredibly grateful for each day of sobriety. I no longer miss the sickness, fear, anxiety, and depression that consumed me when I was drinking.
I want to deeply thank everyone at Miracles Asia, and the incredible people I had the privilege of sharing my recovery journey with. It was truly a life-changing experience.

Speaking as a family member of someone that attended Miracles for 90 days, I cannot say enough good things about them. You are cared for every step of your journey and the family are part of that. You will never find another facility that goes well above and beyond to help you and genuinely care about your recovery. Special thanks to the owner Mark and his wife, Danny and Chris for doing far more than they needed to. We will be forever in your debt for everything you have done for our loved one and for our family. If you are considering a place for your recovery or you are a family thinking to send your loved one somewhere for treatment, you will not go wrong with Miracles. You will be taken care of every step of the way. High Recommend!

My experience at Miracles Asia has been a tremendously enlightening experience of growth and change, to enable myself to constructively engage in a sober lifestyle in society. It gave me a fantastic approach to my recovery, incorporating …

I have struggled with alcohol addiction for too many years. At the very lowest point of my life, I found Miracles Asia. The experience was transformative. All I needed to be was willing to be teachable and to change. As someone with two degrees and high intelligence, it didn't matter with this disease.

I was just a garden variety alcoholic and I needed to get over myself. Miracles helped me see a future I wasn't able to imagine for myself anymore. It was a really hard fought process and I had to want it; I really wanted it.

It is less than six months since I left Miracles and my life is not the same. I was given the tools and the attitude going forward to apply to my 'real life'. I have taken tumbles and I have gotten back up again and the owners and staff are still there if I need them.

I am grateful today. I am changed, yet I am still exactly who I am supposed to be.

Go to Miracles. Go there with the attitude that you will do ANYTHING to get well and you will.

I am truly grateful for the team at Miracles!!!
My life was spinning out of control, I was on the verge of losing my wife and kids and being homeless until I made the decision to seek help.
The 30 days I spent in Phuket, and if I'm being honest, it was one of the hardest times of my life.
I left my wife at home with our four children for 30 days, which put even more strain on our already rocky relationship.
Today I am 111 days sober, and my life has meaning again.
I am present, content, happy and now my wife and kids have the husband/father they deserve.
Thank you to everyone at Miracles Asia for helping me in my darkest days.

Miracles is truly an amazing rehab! It’s not only got me sober, but learnt me how to live a happy sober life! I truly never thought it could of been possible. But it’s all 100% true, and I’m still around to tell the tale.

I’ve been drinking and taking drugs for over 40 years of my life. After two failed attempts at different rehabs, (one being in Cheshire UK, and the other in Chiang Mai) I checked in to Miracles Phuket. When I cheeked in I was drinking over a litre of whiskey a day. Most of my days was in black-out, and I felt like giving up on life. My first few days is still a blare. But didn’t take long before I started to feel a little better after a few days of controlled detoxing by the lovely nurses  every day was getting better and easier.

More about Miracles, most of the staff are X alcoholics/addicts which makes a big difference to  recovery. It’s quite a small luxury rehab, I think around 18 people. every 4/5 rooms as a private pool so you can relax after a busy day in classes, like meditation, yoga, counselling, morning check-in and evening meeting where someone will tell their story or someone will joint the meeting on zoom and tell their story. (listening to all the stories, really help me on my recovery)  not to mention the delicious food cooked chef Mr Pom and his team. (Michelin star) what is really different and special about Miricals. There really do care! And the after care is equally as good, as they continue to keep in touch with you after you leave.

I hope anyone who needs help with alcohol or any other kind of drugs, you really should talk with the team at Miracle.

And a big thank you to Mark, Danny, Kirsten, Mr Pom (chef) and all the team!

You all have really saved my life! I am so grateful and happy!

By a stroke of luck I ended up in Miracles. It took me a few days to come out of my haze & realise that Miracles is in a class of its own. I cannot stress enough the difference between Miracles & other facilities. …

Recently my sister travelled all the way from Bangkok to Miracle Asia and glad that she is being treated with compassion.
Our family had the opportunity to choose between Miracle Asia and a multitude of other luxury treatment centers, something told us that Miracle Rehab was the one.

I'm for a few minutes now struggling to write the correct words that will properly encapsulate and vivify my experience at Miracles to the reader. To be frank, it's impossible for me to accurately summarize the last month in such a short text. Alas, let me try :)

Miracles Asia is an intimate, luxurious and delicious (the food, of course) facility. The facility is owned and operated by folks in recovery - which I find so compelling and important. Far too often, professionals in the space don't have the go-to solutions that you need to recover because they haven't gone through addiction themselves. Not at Miracles. They have literally "been there, done that." So if there is one thing you can be certain about is that nothing that you say (about your addiction) will shock them. They probably have been through it as well.

What also sets Miracles apart is its sheer size. When I was there we were only 4-5 clients, which was AMAZING. I've heard horror stories of other rehabs with 20x that and it's just filled with personality and drama. I got lucky whereby I became great friends with my batch, and even if we didn't mix/get along (which aforementioned, we did - all the time) then at least there was the comfort of privacy and the fact that there was a small group to 'deal' with. I find that addicts in recovery are super sensitive (speaking from experience here) and thus, the less drama the better. Miracle's structure enabled an intimate social environment with superb ratios between staff and clients to boot. That was paramount in my experience, personally.

Lastly, this is a private clinic and the prices are - ON THE SURFACE - not cheap. But compared to the rehabs of American or European variety, there is not a better value on the planet. If Miracles was located in the states it would be 3x the price at least. Not to mention, if the price is holding you back - and it's the only thing holding you back - I invite you to reframe your resistance with the following:

1. How much money has your addiction cost you? What is the loss in your opportunity cost? How much are you willing to pay to stop the bleeding?
2. If you had another more 'socially-acceptable' but equally deadly disease like for example Cancer, wouldn't you want to pay top-dollar for a treatment? Think of this as any other treatment for a terminal issue.
3. You really do receive the value that you pay for on a material level. The facility is gorgeous and the staff are so committed, hospitable and kind. I was impressed

All in all, it's really a great deal (or dare I say, steal)

So in review, my 'top 3' for what sets Miracles apart:

1. First-hand experience of the staff
2. The size
3. Value-for-money.

Thank you so much Miracles for setting my sails in the right direction. I will never forget how you changed my life.

Cheers
